content: Germany RDG s2(1): a Rechtsdienstleistung is any activity in a concrete third-party matter requiring legal examination of the individual case. s2(3) no.5 exempts presentation and discussion of legal questions addressed to the general public in the media. s3 makes independent out-of-court legal services permitted only where a statute allows. ss6/7/8 carve out free services, trade unions and interest associations, and public bodies. s20 provides fines. BGH I ZR 113/20 (Sept 2021) held the Wolters Kluwer smartlaw contract generator is NOT an unauthorised legal service because it does not advise on a concrete individual matter, though the Hamburg bar warned this hollows out the RDG.
